description: Marble Madness (Atari System 1, set 'marble') gameplay sound effects, captured from the 6502 sound program as YM2151/POKEY register streams. Cue bindings map backend-agnostic remaster sound cues (src/remaster/audio/soundCues.ts) to the ROM command the 68010 sends for the same gameplay event. See docs/ROM_SFX.md for addresses and evidence.

source.method: 6502 harness (py65) + YM2151 timer-A IRQ every 7168 CPU cycles; writes deduplicated per register, tick-quantized. Regenerate with scripts/rom-sfx/extract_rom_sfx.py.

marble.wallBump.note: 0x34 from wall resolver 0x1B5C2 (site 0x1B8F4) whenever a velocity component flips sign; no speed scaling in the ROM.

marble.marbleBump.note: 0x37 from marble-marble collision 0x1BC88 (site 0x1BFAC) when both marbles are players.

marble.enemyMarbleBump.note: 0x32 from 0x1BC88 (site 0x1BF9C) when either marble is a black marble (0x4009A4 / 0x400A20).

marble.airborne.note: 0x45 falling sound when the marble leaves the ground (0x121B8 site 0x12482, ledges 0x1642C/0x16642, piston 0x18920, catapult pipe exit 0x255A4); stopped by 0x46.

marble.landing.note: 0x5D POKEY thud after any fall (0x121B8 site 0x124DA, right after 0x46).

marble.broomSweep.note: 0x5F at shatter animation frame 9 (0x25FC2 site 0x26062, animation 0x215F6).

marble.dazed.note: 0x39 dazed loop: medium landing (0x25C74 site 0x25DAA), marble bumps a worm/enemy (0x14E92 site 0x15076); stopped by helper 0x15884 (0x3A then 0x3B, 0x3B skipped on level index 2). Also sent when the black marble lands on a player (0x1BFE4).

marble.lostOffEdge.note: 0x3D from 0x25BAE kind 4 (site 0x25C54): lethal landing off-screen or fall into the abyss (> 0x800000 below take-off, 0x1269E).

marble.lost.note: 0x3C from 0x25BAE kind 4 with $57 == 0x65 (site 0x25C44) and 0x25230 (site 0x25346): marble removed from play.

marble.vacuumCapture.note: Level 4 vacuum capture ends with 0x3C (site 0x256AC) after stopping the hum.

marble.eaten.note: 0x33 worm swallows the marble (enemy behaviour 0x15460, site 0x153A2); afterwards the marble is removed with 0x3C (site 0x25C44).

marble.birdGrab.note: 0x3E (site 0x19E20): Level 5 creature catches the marble; medium confidence it is the bird.

marble.acidMelt.note: 0x5E POKEY noise swell (site 0x17698) when the marble overlaps one of the 7 acid objects at 0x401482 (melt sprite table 0x21062).

pipe.enter.note: 0x35 pipe entry (actor collision 0x29CD2, types 0x12/0x13/0x14/0x20/0x25, sites 0x2A46A/0x2A538/0x2A6E2/0x2A956); 0x36 for type 0x22 (site 0x2A82E). Intensity < 0.5 selects 0x35.

goal.arrive.note: 0x2F (P1) / 0x30 (P2) 'Goal In' from 0x13966 when the section becomes 0xFF (site 0x13874, table 0x1EF72).

race.catchUp.note: 2P off-screen catch-up (-5 SEC) removes the trailing marble with 0x3C.

bonus.extraTime.note: 0x53 magic wand / secret +10 s bonus (0x253EC site 0x2571A; checked once per level at 0x1BBAA).

bonus.squashMiniature.note: 0x5A/0x5B/0x5C when squashing a Level 5 miniature (+3 s, 0x19250); ROM picks by actor $25 (7 -> 0x5B, 9 -> 0x5C, else 0x5A). Intensity ladder used as a stand-in.

level.pistonNear.note: Level 4 piston pop-up on screen (0x1844A, table 0x1EFB6).

level.vacuumHum.note: Level 4 vacuum hum loops (start table 0x1EF42, stop table 0x1EF5A, indexed by section - 0x1E).

level.actorBounce.note: 0x42 bounce off a solid actor (types 0x05, 0x1A-0x1F) in 0x29CD2.

marble.onIce.note: 0x43 loop when the marble enters ice tiles 0x35-0x37 (site 0x2B19C, called via jsr (a4) = sound 0x158AC); 0x44 stops it on leaving (site 0x2B1EE). Also sent at Aerial level start (0x10F8A). Cross-checked with the parallel Level 2 ice-zone analysis.
